data.title: Four-Digit Place Value Explorer
data.description: Learn to read and understand thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones in four-digit numbers.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count each column from thousands down to ones.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Be careful with the empty tens column when reading the blocks.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Check the hundreds column before reading the tens and ones.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Look closely at the ones column to see how many units are there.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Notice which columns have blocks and which ones are empty.
